newsitem.title: INDIA: India to announce new economic measures this week.
newsitem.headline: India to announce new economic measures this week.

text.p: Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda said on Monday that new economic measures will be announced this week to bolster India's fluctuating capital markets.

"Some decisions have been taken and some steps have been taken. Further steps will be taken before the World Economic Forum meeting on January 31 at Davos," Deve Gowda said referring to a gathering in Switzerland of leading politicians and economists.
